item.tib: rig 'dzin thugs kyi rtsa brgyud gnams lcags thog mda' las dbang byang rin chen gter khyims
item.coloph: rig 'dzin dpal bo bdun bsgrub (sgrub) las/ rig 'dzin brgyud (rgyud) pa'i dbang bskur bstan/ rig 'dzin brgyud (rgyud) pa'i dbang bskur ba/ brgyud pa'i byin brlabs 'jug cing / sde brgyad bran du 'khor ba'i gnad yod do//
